views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  payment.customer_id,
  customer.first_name,
  customer.last_name,
  payment.payment_id,
  payment.amount,
  payment.payment_date,
  payment.last_update
FROM payment
JOIN customer ON customer.customer_id = payment.customer_id
views.description:
Task: Find the customer whose average monthly change in payment amounts is the highest, and return that customer's full name.
Required outputs: full name of the customer (first and last name combined
